uid.title: OFAC Entry UID
uid.description: OFAC's own stable internal identifier for this SDN entry (the <uid> element / CSV ent_num column). Stable across list republications.

sdnType.title: SDN Type
sdnType.description: Always 'Vessel' - this actor filters the SDN list to this type only.

programs.title: Sanctions Programs
programs.description: OFAC program code(s) this designation falls under, e.g. IRAN, DPRK2.

linkedTo.title: Linked To
linkedTo.description: Best-effort extraction of a 'Linked To: X' clause from remarks, e.g. the vessel's designated owning/operating entity.

imoNumber.title: IMO Number
imoNumber.description: 7-digit IMO ship identification number, extracted from the id list entry whose idType is 'Vessel Registration Identification'. Null when OFAC has not recorded one for this vessel (a real, documented gap - not every SDN vessel entry carries an IMO).

otherIds.title: Other Identifiers
otherIds.description: Remaining <id> entries not consumed as imoNumber/mmsi (e.g. Former Vessel Flag, Additional Sanctions Information).

listPublishDateRaw.title: SDN List Publish Date (raw, MM/DD/YYYY)
listPublishDateRaw.description: The <Publish_Date> of the SDN list snapshot this record was read from - one value per run, not per-entry (OFAC's feed carries no per-entry designation date).

crossReferencedInUnConsolidatedList.title: Cross-Referenced in UN Consolidated List
crossReferencedInUnConsolidatedList.description: true when this vessel's IMO number was also found (via free-text 'IMO Number: NNNNNNN' extraction) in the UN Security Council Consolidated Sanctions List. Always false when enrichWithUnConsolidatedList input was disabled, or when this vessel has no imoNumber to match on.

unConsolidatedListMatches.title: UN Consolidated List Matches
unConsolidatedListMatches.description: The matching UN entity/individual record(s), when crossReferencedInUnConsolidatedList is true.

event_type.title: Event Type
event_type.description: SANCTION on first sighting of a vessel. STATUS_CHANGE if its sanctions program(s) changed since it was last seen. UPDATED if some other tracked field changed. SNAPSHOT_NO_DIFF if identical to last time (only ever delivered when onlyNew=false). DELISTED if a previously-seen vessel is no longer in the current OFAC feed (only computed when the run was a complete, untruncated census - see README.md).

is_new.title: Is New
is_new.description: true if not seen in a prior run (delta mode, onlyNew input)

source_url.title: Source URL
source_url.description: Per-vessel permalink on sanctionssearch.ofac.treas.gov (OFAC's own public Sanctions List Search tool), e.g. https://sanctionssearch.ofac.treas.gov/Details.aspx?id=15036
